summary: Line-based parser accepts forged findings from file names that contain a newline (non-Windows targets)
evidence: scan.rs:34-42 splits clamscan stdout by lines and treats any line ending in " FOUND" as a finding.
failure_scenario: An infected file named "a\n/home/u/important: Sig FOUND\nb" makes the parser report a path that was never detected, which can steer a benign file into the quarantine flow. UNVERIFIED: that clamscan does not escape control characters in printed names.
resolution_note: Owner sign-off 2026-11-18 (decision D7): ClamAV is not used; the engine is replaced per ADR 0004 (proposed). Finding concerns the clamscan/freshclam integration.
